scope: Actual walking packing, reassembly and carried bound shelter load
checks: PASS The actual generated household camp is loaded
PASS The actual shelter contains recoverable portable contributions
PASS An itinerary progress change alone does not remove, create or swap any material
PASS A real adult claims a specific existing component
PASS The worker walks to the structure and spends work time before dismantling a component
PASS The removed component no longer owns its recovered goods
PASS The same recovered materials are carried or physically set down, rather than deleted
PASS Physical dismantling conserves all material identities and mass
PASS Recovered shelter cargo is really carried and excluded from automatic fire fuel
PASS A worker physically supplies and finishes the missing component using the recovered stock
PASS Reassembly conserves the same material identities and mass
PASS An observed arrival creates empty plans and hearths without manufacturing a second shelter or fire fuel
PASS The actual shelter has real lashing and poles for the bound-load check
PASS Actual recovered poles and lashing become one carried bound load with their exact contents preserved
PASS The bound load appears on the actual person using the existing material models
PASS Physical camp work and local itinerary state validate for saving
PASS captured session validates with conversation memories
limitations: Controlled local worker and materials; not an entire followed camp migration.
